newspec-c: failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））
Reproduced in 3 runs (no spec change after review). Device B (Honolulu, clock = server - 2 days) Save & Extract 'Hold lisinopril, BP soft.' (hold answered at the socket): stored changeDate 'Oct 11', row updatedAt and medicationsUpdatedAt 2026-10-12T07:02 (server 2026-10-14T07:02). B's screenshot 'Held · Oct 11' was taken before the server lifecycle ran; once it ran (AppLayout ContextLifecycle: whenever a page enters the Hospital section on any device, then every 10 min) it deleted the held row against its 2-day-old stamp: server medications [] and A's Medication Tracker 'No medications recorded.' Recorded only (gated TFA-94699, U20): the resident's visit date stored as B's day 'Sun Oct 11 2026'.
产品问题: A physician on a phone/laptop whose date is two days behind dictates 'Hold lisinopril, BP soft.' and taps Save & Extract: the hold is stamped 'Held · Oct 11' and, the next time the server lifecycle runs (any device entering the Hospital section, or the 10-minute timer), the lisinopril row is deleted: the Medication Tracker shows 'No medications recorded.' on every device. The tracker stamps (mergeMedEventsIntoList / useMedicationEventExtraction) use the device clock (new Date() / Date.now()). Breaks UAT 3.8 / U23 (server time; a wrong-clock device shows the same state) and TC-19 U1 (holds stay visible as open loops with their date).

testCase.name: [本地] S19 A browser two days behind and in another time zone writes the server's date on holds and stamps (both modes)

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B18 · P1 · 已知

很多时间和日期按设备时钟算，没有用服务器时间（违反 UAT 3.8）：「NEW TODAY」、入院日期、体征日期、任务完成时间、转录日期都跟着手机走；手机慢两天时停药被打成两天前，下次清理就把这个药删了

票：TFA-92584 ready for qa（UAT 3.8） · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地

注：根因已知（Daniela 10-03 提过要用服务器时间）；删药、掉标签、草稿恢复错这几个症状是新的

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-01/S08, TC-10/S22, TC-12/S23, TC-22/S23, TC-25/S24a, TC-02/S13b, EFS/S28, TC-16/S25

思路 / Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S19 「一个慢两天、在别的时区的浏览器，在暂停和时间戳上写服务器的日期（两种模式）」 A browser two days behind and in another time zone writes the server's date on holds and stamps (both modes)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U23 Server day for the dates the tracker writes: a hold/stop/start tag ('Held · Mon D'), a row's updatedAt and the chart's medicationsUpdatedAt follow the server's day and time, whatever the device clock …（UAT 3.8；TFA-92597 R6 (hold/stop keeps its date)）
  • U20 Server clock for the retention clocks: the 18 h label, the 36 h clears and the Nursing Home visit date that drives last-two-visits follow the server clock; …（UAT 3.8；TFA-94699 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U8 Hold/stop dates and reasons are the ones dictated and are kept on every later save; they are never changed to the save date.（UAT TC-19 ER 5；UAT TC-19 ER 10；TFA-92597 R6）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Local stack; one fresh @roundai.test physician signed in on two Playwright browser contexts against localhost:6473: context A with the real clock, context B with page.clock set to server time - 2 days and timezoneId 'Pacific/Honolulu' (UTC-10); a Hospital patient with lisinopril active and a Nursing Home resident

When On context B: Save & Extract 'Hold lisinopril, BP soft.' on the Hospital patient, and a pre-round Save Note on the resident. Then open both charts on context A, and read rounding:get / snf:get on the server

Then The Held tag shows the server's day ('Mon D') on both contexts; the row's updatedAt and the chart's medicationsUpdatedAt are within a minute of server time; the resident's newest snfVisitDates entry is the server's day; the row is not cleared or labelled 'not mentioned today' at once on either context

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U23 (not gated: UAT 3.8 + TFA-92597 R6): the Held tag date and the row / chart stamps; a wrong date here is a Fail on the ready-for-qa ticket, and a likely one on main, where mergeMedEventsIntoList and useMedicationEventExtraction stamp new Date() / Date.now() in the browser (day roll is the known TFA-92584). …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-c（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S19 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-19.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：新的产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92597 ready for qa；TFA-94699 in progress

手机日期慢两天时，口述「Hold lisinopril」被记成「Held · Oct 11」，下一次服务器清理就把这行删掉，之后所有设备都显示「No medications recorded.」。

If a phone's date is two days behind, a dictated 'Hold lisinopril' is stamped 'Held · Oct 11', and the next server lifecycle run deletes the lisinopril row, so every device then shows 'No medications recorded.'

依据：Allure 2e31b3cf, newspec-c failed, reproduced in 3 runs. mergeMedEventsIntoList and useMedicationEventExtraction stamp with the device clock. This breaks TC-19 U23 (ungated; UAT 3.8) and U1. The resident visit-date part (U20, gated by TFA-94699) is recorded only. The matrix's U23 text predicted device-clock stamping from code reading, but there is no known-gap or ledger entry. Same class as TC-16/S25.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-c。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：newspec-c。

UAT item: TC-19 Medication Tracker · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-19/S19

A browser two days behind and in another time zone writes the server's date on holds and stamps (both modes)

Tickets: TFA-92597 Medication Tracker (ready for qa); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

本地新 lane newspec-c：newspec-c/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（newspec-c/plan.json，automatable: yes）：New Playwright spec: one fresh account, two browser contexts on it. Context B: timezoneId Pacific/Honolulu and clock = server now - 2 days (context.clock.install). Hospital patient with Lisinopril active; ai/parsing:extractMedicationEvents answered at B's socket with a hold event (extractTasks empty) so the stamp, not the model, is under test. B: Encounter 'Hold lisinopril, BP soft.' -> Save & Extract; B: resident pre-round Save Note (parse answered at the socket). Read rounding:get / snf:get (JWT): row updatedAt, medicationsUpdatedAt within 60 s of server time (time:now), row changeDate / Held tag = server day; resident snfVisitDates newest = server day. Context A (real clock) opens both charts: Held tag shows the server's day on both contexts, row still there. — Browser clock, time zone and a second context are standard Playwright; the server's time comes from the app's own time:now mutation.

Detail:

Reproduced in 3 runs (no spec change after review). Device B (Honolulu, clock = server - 2 days) Save & Extract 'Hold lisinopril, BP soft.' (hold answered at the socket): stored changeDate 'Oct 11', row updatedAt and medicationsUpdatedAt 2026-10-12T07:02 (server 2026-10-14T07:02). B's screenshot 'Held · Oct 11' was taken before the server lifecycle ran; once it ran (AppLayout ContextLifecycle: whenever a page enters the Hospital section on any device, then every 10 min) it deleted the held row against its 2-day-old stamp: server medications [] and A's Medication Tracker 'No medications recorded.' Recorded only (gated TFA-94699, U20): the resident's visit date stored as B's day 'Sun Oct 11 2026'.

产品问题：A physician on a phone/laptop whose date is two days behind dictates 'Hold lisinopril, BP soft.' and taps Save & Extract: the hold is stamped 'Held · Oct 11' and, the next time the server lifecycle runs (any device entering the Hospital section, or the 10-minute timer), the lisinopril row is deleted: the Medication Tracker shows 'No medications recorded.' on every device. The tracker stamps (mergeMedEventsIntoList / useMedicationEventExtraction) use the device clock (new Date() / Date.now()). Breaks UAT 3.8 / U23 (server time; a wrong-clock device shows the same state) and TC-19 U1 (holds stay visible as open loops with their date).

证据：附了 3 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our scripted spec, not written yet): two Playwright contexts on one fresh @roundai.test account, one with page.clock and timezoneId, plus backend reads; its given and runnerGap keep it on the local stack (never ).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
